questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that pedestrians cross here. Watch for people in the crosswalk. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign means the divided highway is ending soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show which way the road curves. The arrow points in the direction of the curve. You may see several of these signs along a sharp curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of an intersection ahead where a road joins from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a hospital with emergency services is to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. U-turns are forbidden where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns of a winding road. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal to tell drivers that left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. You must stop completely and look for pedestrians and cross traffic. Make sure the intersection is clear before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid accidents.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and approaching vehicles pass first. Only stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals can be used instead of or along with turn signals. A left arm extended straight out to the left signals a left turn or lane change to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider raises their left arm with one finger pointing up, all riders should move into a single-file line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roadways separated by a median or guide rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, but you may not always need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always come to a complete stop. Only proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that shows traffic rules you must obey. Where this sign is posted, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn you about special situations or potential hazards ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and drive a different way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending. Traffic in the right lane must move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When your left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it signals a right turn or right lane change.
